children.name: Support 0 summary
children.text: How do I choose a product?

children.name: Support answer 0
children.text: Use the product selector to explore the collection. Check the photos and product description before choosing the option that suits you.

children.name: Support 1 summary
children.text: Can I change my options and quantity?

children.name: Support answer 1
children.text: Choose an available option and set the quantity before adding it to your cart. Choices are kept separately for each product. You can also change quantities in the cart.

children.name: Support answer 2
children.text: Delivery options, where applicable, are shown at checkout. Return terms follow the seller’s policy. Review the information provided by the seller before ordering.

children.name: Support 3 summary
children.text: What should I check before checkout?

children.name: Support answer 3
children.text: Confirm the product, option, quantity and subtotal in your cart. Review your contact, payment and delivery details where applicable before confirming the order.

children.name: Policy copy contact 0
children.text: Read the product description and available options for details about each item. Check your cart before continuing to checkout.

children.name: Policy copy contact 1
children.text: For an existing order, open its details in Ezkart to find the information and help provided by the seller. Include your order number when asking for help.

children.name: Policy copy privacy 0
children.text: The cart uses browser storage to remember your selected products. Use its quantity controls to change or remove items.

children.name: Policy copy privacy 1
children.text: Information needed to complete an order is requested at checkout. Review the seller’s privacy information before providing your details.

children.name: Policy copy terms 0
children.text: Product names, descriptions, options and prices come from the seller’s catalog. Check the selected option and total before confirming your order.

children.name: Policy copy terms 1
children.text: Delivery and return terms follow the seller’s policies. Read the information provided for your order before purchasing.
